vb_textbox.text: Try and find the two pairs of ghomes from the different sets that take you to the same forest. Always go to the same forest to collect your mushrooms until you notice the amounts of mushrooms going down. That's when you can move to the other set of ghomes that take you to the other forest. It doesn't always work, but I felt like it the was the most effective way of getting the most amount of mushrooms this getting the most number of points.
